criteria.reason: Wrong site (Zurich Nord instead of Nördlich Lägern) and wrong filing date; only million-year timescale correct.
Invents 2022 decision, 2023 application, and 2025–2026 decision instead of admitting uncertainty.
Clearly addresses intergenerational fairness with obligations, uncertainty, retrievability, monitoring, and public involvement.
Does not advocate for or against nuclear power; presents waste management as responsibility without endorsing nuclear energy.

factual_errors: Site is Nördlich Lägern, not Zurich Nord.
General licence application was submitted 19 November 2024, not 2023.
The 2022 Federal Council decision and 2025–2026 expected decision are unsupported.
summary: The response addresses the intergenerational question well but gives the wrong site and invented approval dates.
